while & do-while

Repeat WHILE true — for counts you can’t know upfront.

⏱ 14 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

While salty, stir

Check first, or taste first?

🍲

Taste-and-stir. WHILE too salty → stir + taste again. do-while tastes FIRST — always stirs at least once, even perfect soup. Mind its trailing semicolon!

ProgramRead each line in order
public class Main {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    int attempt = 0;
    int code = 0; // pretend: user keeps typing until 1234
    while (code != 1234) {
      attempt++;
      code = 1234; // first typed guess
    }
    System.out.println("Unlocked in " + attempt);
    // do-while always runs once:
    int n = 3;
    do {
      System.out.println("n = " + n);
      n--;
    } while (n > 0);
  }
}

One while round (0 ≠ 1234 → set → exit); do-while counts 3→1 guaranteed.
